**Finding: GOVLAW — compliant (no redline).**

- **Governing law (Section 10.5, p0426):** New York internal law, including GOL §§ 5-1401/5-1402, with an express anti-amendment lock preventing any change away from New York law. This meets the preferred element in full.
- **Forum (Section 10.6, p0427):** Submission to the SDNY and New York State courts sitting in New York, New York, with irrevocable waiver of venue and inconvenient-forum objections. Accepted New York courts; the submission is *nonexclusive* rather than exclusive New York County jurisdiction — a sub-element short of preferred, noted rather than flagged.
- **Arbitration (Section 11.2, p0450–p0473):** Optional (the Requesting Party may instead institute a legal proceeding), limited to unresolved reacquisition/acquisition requests, administered by JAMS/AAA, and expressly held in New York, New York. Domestic and non-displacing — no foreign-seat walk-away trigger.

The clause sits at or above the fallback on its material terms, so we are not redlining it.
